gaps.lead: Although the traffic was heavy, we reached the airport in time.
gaps.sentence: We reached the airport in time ___ traffic.
gaps.explanation: 'Although the traffic was heavy' becomes 'despite the heavy traffic' — despite + noun phrase.

gaps.lead: It would be sensible to leave before the traffic builds up.
gaps.sentence: We ___ before the traffic builds up.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be sensible to do' = 'we had better do' — had better + bare infinitive.

gaps.lead: 'I'll definitely call you when I land,' she told me.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call; the person promised shifts to 'me'.

gaps.lead: Her French improved because she spent years in Lyon.
gaps.sentence: Her French improved as ___ in Lyon.
gaps.explanation: as a result of + noun/-ing = because of.

gaps.lead: You didn't tell me about the meeting, and you should have.
gaps.sentence: You really ___ me about the meeting.
gaps.explanation: ought to have + participle = should have done (but didn't).

gaps.lead: I can't wait to see you again.
